Nkyea
1 # Gal 1.11-12 Paulo a ɛmfiri nnipa, nso ɛnnam onipa bi so, na mmom ɛnam Yesu Kristo ne Agya Nyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no so na ɔyɛ ɔsomafoɔ 2ne anuanom a wɔka me ho nyinaa de kɔma Galatia asafo ahodoɔ: 3#Rom 1.7 Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo. 4#Gal 2.20; 1 Ti 2.6; Tito 2.14; 1 Yoh 5.19 Ɔno na yɛn bɔne nti ɔde ne ho maeɛ na wayi yɛn afiri wiase bɔne yi mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn pɛ no teɛ. 5Ɔno na animuonyam nka no mmeresanten mfesanten. Amen.
Galatifoɔ nsaneakyire
6Ɛyɛ me nwanwa sɛ moatwe mo ho ntɛm saa afiri deɛ wafrɛ mo Kristo adom mu no ho kɔ asɛmpa foforɔ bi mu 7#Aso 15.1; 15.24 a nso ɛnyɛ asɛmpa foforɔ biara; na mmom nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔha mo na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsesa Kristo asɛmpa no. 8#1 Ko 16.22 Na sɛ mpo yɛn anaa abɔfoɔ bi firi soro ba bɛka asɛmpa foforɔ bi kyerɛ mo, ka deɛ yɛka kyerɛɛ mo no ho a, ɔnnue! 9Sɛdeɛ yɛkaa no kane no, saa ara na afei mereka bio, sɛ obi ba bɛka asɛmpa foforɔ bi kyerɛ mo ka deɛ moagyeɛ no ho a, ɔnnue! 10#1 Te 2.4 Na afei anim pa na merehwehwɛ afiri nnipa hɔ anaasɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn hɔ? Anaasɛ mehwehwɛ sɛ mesɔ nnipa ani anaa? Sɛ meda so mesɔ nnipa ani a, ɛnneɛ na menyɛ Kristo akoa.
Paulo nkyerɛkyerɛ firi Kristo
11Na anuanom, merema moahunu sɛ, asɛmpa a mekaeɛ no nte sɛ nnipa adeɛ; 12ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ nnipa nkyɛn na megyee no, nso wɔamfa ankyerɛkyerɛ me, na mmom Yesu Kristo na ɔdaa no adi kyerɛɛ me. 13#Aso 26.4-20 Na moate abrabɔ a akane no na mebɔ no wɔ Yudafoɔ som mu, sɛdeɛ metaataa Nyankopɔn asafo maa no boroo soɔ, na mesɛee wɔn, 14na menyaa nkɔsoɔ Yudafoɔ som mu kyɛnee m’atipɛnfoɔ bebree m’abusua mu, na mebɔɔ agyanom atetesɛm ho mmɔden bebree maa no traa so. 15#Rom 1.1; Yer 1.5 Na ɛsɔɔ deɛ ɔyii me firii me na yam, na ɔnam n’adom so afrɛ me no ani 16#Mat 16.17; Gal 2.7 sɛ ɔbɛda ne Ba adi me mu no, sɛ menka ne ho asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanaman no, ntɛm ara mene honam ne mogya antu agyina, 17nso mankɔ Yerusalem wɔn a wɔdii m’anim yɛɛ asomafoɔ no nkyɛn, na mmom mekɔɔ Arabia, na mesane mebaa Damasko bio.
Nsra a ɔkɔsraa Yerusalem, Siria ne Kilikia
18 # Aso 9.26 Ɛnna mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyiri no, mekɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ merekɔhwɛ Kefa anim, na medii ne nkyɛn dadu nnanum, 19#Mat 13.55 na asomafoɔ a ɛkeka ho no deɛ manhunu wɔn mu biara, gye Awurade nua Yakobo. 20Na deɛ meretwerɛ mo yi, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn anim, merenni atorɔ. 21#Aso 9.30 Ɛno akyiri no, mebaa Siria ne Kilikia fam. 22Na Yudea asafo a wɔwɔ Kristo mu no nnim m’anim; 23na teɛ nko ara na na wɔate sɛ, deɛ anka kane no ɔtaa yɛn no, afei deɛ, ɔka gyidie a akane no na ɔsɛe no no ho asɛmpa. 24Na me nti wɔhyɛɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo a ɛmfiri nnipa, nso ɛnnam onipa bi so, na mmom ɛnam Yesu Kristo ne Agya Nyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no so na ɔyɛ ɔsomafoɔ ne anuanom a wɔka me ho nyinaa de kɔma Galatia asafo ahodoɔ: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo. Ɔno na yɛn bɔne nti ɔde ne ho maeɛ na wayi yɛn afiri wiase bɔne yi mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn pɛ no teɛ. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no mmeresanten mfesanten. Amen.

Ɛyɛ me nwanwa sɛ moatwe mo ho ntɛm saa afiri deɛ wafrɛ mo Kristo adom mu no ho kɔ asɛmpa foforɔ bi mu a nso ɛnyɛ asɛmpa foforɔ biara; na mmom nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔha mo na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsesa Kristo asɛmpa no. Na sɛ mpo yɛn anaa abɔfoɔ bi firi soro ba bɛka asɛmpa foforɔ bi kyerɛ mo, ka deɛ yɛka kyerɛɛ mo no ho a, ɔnnue! Sɛdeɛ yɛkaa no kane no, saa ara na afei mereka bio, sɛ obi ba bɛka asɛmpa foforɔ bi kyerɛ mo ka deɛ moagyeɛ no ho a, ɔnnue! Na afei anim pa na merehwehwɛ afiri nnipa hɔ anaasɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn hɔ? Anaasɛ mehwehwɛ sɛ mesɔ nnipa ani anaa? Sɛ meda so mesɔ nnipa ani a, ɛnneɛ na menyɛ Kristo akoa.

Na anuanom, merema moahunu sɛ, asɛmpa a mekaeɛ no nte sɛ nnipa adeɛ; ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ nnipa nkyɛn na megyee no, nso wɔamfa ankyerɛkyerɛ me, na mmom Yesu Kristo na ɔdaa no adi kyerɛɛ me. Na moate abrabɔ a akane no na mebɔ no wɔ Yudafoɔ som mu, sɛdeɛ metaataa Nyankopɔn asafo maa no boroo soɔ, na mesɛee wɔn, na menyaa nkɔsoɔ Yudafoɔ som mu kyɛnee m’atipɛnfoɔ bebree m’abusua mu, na mebɔɔ agyanom atetesɛm ho mmɔden bebree maa no traa so. Na ɛsɔɔ deɛ ɔyii me firii me na yam, na ɔnam n’adom so afrɛ me no ani sɛ ɔbɛda ne Ba adi me mu no, sɛ menka ne ho asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanaman no, ntɛm ara mene honam ne mogya antu agyina, nso mankɔ Yerusalem wɔn a wɔdii m’anim yɛɛ asomafoɔ no nkyɛn, na mmom mekɔɔ Arabia, na mesane mebaa Damasko bio.

Ɛnna mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyiri no, mekɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ merekɔhwɛ Kefa anim, na medii ne nkyɛn dadu nnanum, na asomafoɔ a ɛkeka ho no deɛ manhunu wɔn mu biara, gye Awurade nua Yakobo. Na deɛ meretwerɛ mo yi, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn anim, merenni atorɔ. Ɛno akyiri no, mebaa Siria ne Kilikia fam. Na Yudea asafo a wɔwɔ Kristo mu no nnim m’anim; na teɛ nko ara na na wɔate sɛ, deɛ anka kane no ɔtaa yɛn no, afei deɛ, ɔka gyidie a akane no na ɔsɛe no no ho asɛmpa. Na me nti wɔhyɛɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
